observation: A test that applied the global 0.15 mm thin-card clearance to every card class rejected the declared 3.0 mm acrylic class even though that class uses 0.10 mm per side in the design contract.
correction: Store side_clearance_mm on every declared card interface class.
Use the same class record in parameter validation, virtual placement, interface reporting and tests.
Do not silently substitute a global clearance for heterogeneous interface classes.
limitations: One slot profile and three virtual card classes were checked.
No physical insertion force, polymer compliance or card-thickness distribution was measured.
